title: Partner marketplace fast-track: asset checklist + hero & microcopy bank
content:
PURPOSE
Quick, pragmatic checklist + copy pack to fast-track partner listings into cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP). Not a canonical policy doc — this is a compact operational kit for PMs, partner managers, and content owners to ship initial listings and demos.

SUMMARY (one-liner)
Make it unmistakable what the partner integration does, who it’s for, and the one measurable outcome (time saved, cost avoided, security/compliance benefit).

ASSET CHECKLIST (minimum viable listing)
- Product & legal
  - Short product name (<= 50 chars) — canonical SKU-friendly name.
  - 1-line tagline (<= 120 chars) that includes primary benefit + audience.
  - 2–3 sentence summary (marketplace detail page). Keep one sentence about data handling (where customer data flows).
  - Pricing model: free-trial / metered / subscription + example plan text.
  - Link to TOS / privacy and a note about PII handling for integrations.

- Visuals / creative
  - Tile image: 1024x512 PNG (background: dark/neutral; include small Redwood + partner co-brand).
  - Logo: SVG + 512px PNG (transparent). Dark & light variants.
  - 3 quick screenshots for detail page: annotated (callouts) 1200x800.
  - Demo video: 45–90s MP4, 16:9, includes product + integration callout (hosted on partner channel or Redwood CDN).

- Technical & onboarding
  - Quick start URL (1-click sign-up / trial provisioning) and expected time-to-first-call (e.g., 2 minutes).
  - Integration docs link (public), minimal flow diagram, supported data regions.
  - SSO/SCIM support note: yes/no + links to SAML/OIDC guides.
  - KMS/HSM integration line if customer-keyed encryption supported.
  - Compliance badges: SOC2 / ISO27001 / HIPAA (if applicable).

- Marketplace-specific metadata
  - Categories / tags (3–5).
  - Supported regions (AWS: us-east-1, eu-west-1 etc.).
  - Entitlements/Marketplace SKUs: billing mapping doc or sample SKU names.
  - Contact for technical validation (email + slack handle).

HERO & MICROCOPY BANK (variants to A/B quickly)
- Hero short (tile) — 25–35 chars  1) "Low-latency LLM inference for apps"  2) "Predictable, production LLM serving"  3) "Ship LLM features with reliable SLOs"

- Tagline / subtitle (60–120 chars)  1) "High-throughput model serving, autoscaling pools, and cost controls — ready for production."  2) "Bring your models or use curated open models; get consistent latency and transparent pricing."

- One-paragraph detail copy (single option for detail page)  "Redwood Inference provides a unified LLM serving platform so product teams can ship chat, generation, and embedding features with predictable latency and unit costs. Choose hosted or dedicated capacity, pin model versions, and monitor token-level cost and latency from day one. Includes built-in fallbacks and rollout controls for production resiliency."

- CTA variants  - Primary CTA: "Start free trial" / "Try in minutes" / "Request dedicated demo"  - Secondary CTA: "View pricing" / "See benchmarks"

FEATURE BULLETS (short, 3 items — use in listing highlights)  - "Production-grade latency and throughput with autoscaling"  - "Transparent, per-token cost breakdowns and memory-friendly batching"  - "Private deployments and enterprise key management"

DEMO SCRIPT (45–90s) — acceptance test style- Flow: Sign up -> create API key -> run a 10-turn chat -> show metrics + fallback to smaller model when load spikes- Acceptance checks:  - onboarding succeeds in <=3 minutes  - sample chat response latency < 150ms for short prompts on dedicated SKU (demo config)  - cost breakdown visible in console (token split)  - audit log shows the request and model version ID

MARKETPLACE PRE-FLIGHT TECH CHECK (ops)
- Verify routing & regional availability: can we route US users to us-east? test synthetic requests from regions.
- Billing test: confirm metered SKU increments on test charge and invoice stub appears.
- Security: run a minimal pen-test checklist for the demo flow (auth, token leak, public assets).
- Asset audit: ensure no PII in screenshots or demo video subtitles.

COPY GUIDELINES & DON’TS
- Use active verbs, avoid vague claims like "best" or "industry-leading" unless backed by a benchmark link.
- Call out data residency and encryption clearly.
- Keep tile copy tight — marketplace truncates after ~40 chars on some surfaces.

LOCALIZATION & VARIANTS
- Quick localized CTA bank (EN/FR/DE/JP):  - EN: "Start free trial"  - FR: "Commencer l'essai gratuit"  - DE: "Kostenlose Testversion starten"  - JP: "無料トライアルを開始"

OPEN QUESTIONS / RISKS (owners & next steps)
- Q: Pricing SKU mapping for EU customers — accounting needs final list. Owner: Ben Torres. Due: 2025-10-10.
- Q: Demo video hosting (partner CDN vs Redwood CDN) — legal prefers partner-hosted. Owner: Priya. Due: 2025-10-07.
- Risk: Marketplace review delays if security docs absent. Mitigation: attach SOC2 summary + runbook. Owner: Samira.

DELIVERY CHECKPOINTS (timeline stub)
- Day 0: Assets collected (logos, tile, screens).
- Day 2: Draft listing created in vendor portal + billing SKU stub.
- Day 4: Internal validation + demo smoke tests.
- Day 7: Submit listing for marketplace review.

SNIPPET KITCHEN (quick copy to paste into forms)
- Short description (for tile): "Run LLM-powered features with predictable latency and cost — hosted, dedicated, or private."
- Long description (for detail page): "Redwood Inference helps engineering teams run production LLM workloads with transparent pricing, rollout controls, and enterprise-grade security. Ideal for chat, summarization, and retrieval-augmented generation at scale."
- Support blurb: "24/5 developer support; enterprise SLAs available on Dedicated plans."

TODOS (immediate)
- [ ] Finalize tile image (Ethan)
- [ ] Upload SAML guide link (Priya)
- [ ] Confirm billing SKU names with finance (Ben)
- [ ] Record 60s demo clip with captions (Samira)

NOTES TO SELF
- If listing asks for customer logos, use explicit permission checklist.
- Marketplaces sometimes require legal to sign a separate publisher agreement; have legal contact queued.
- Keep a one-slide appendix of benchmarks (latency/cost) to attach to detail page if reviewer asks.

END - lightweight, copy-forward pack to get a partner listing into vendor portals quickly. Keep this doc as the ephemeral working copy; canonical final assets should land in the marketplace-assets repo and the Confluence vendor page linked above.
